{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gamorrean dueling knife''' was a traditional weapon used by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], commonly in sets of two units. It was a throwing knife that could also be used at close range.

Gamorrean thug [[Ughok Snorg]] used Gamorrean dueling knives as his weapon of choice.
